nodes.name: Calcination of Ir-impregnated MOFs
nodes.procedure: Ir-doped CoMn₂O₄ spinel oxide (ICM), in which Ir single atoms are dispersed in Mn-Co bimetallic oxide nanoparticles, was synthesized by calcinating Ir-impregnated metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) in air (for a detailed description on the synthesis of ICM, see Note S1 and Figures S1-S5).

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-AES shows Ir content increase from 5.6 to 11.3 wt% in ICM_activated due to Co leaching.
nodes.evidence_snippet: During the activation, a complete leaching of Co and a partial leaching of Mn were detected with ICP-AES, while the Ir content was found to remain in the catalyst, leading to an increase in the Ir content from 5.6 to 11.3 wt% in ICM_activated...

nodes.characterization_summary: Cs-corrected HAADF-STEM reveals intergrowth of ramsdellite (1×2 tunnel) and pyrolusite (1×1 tunnel) characteristic of γ-MnO₂ structure in ICM_activated.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The intergrowth of ramsdellite (1×2 tunnel) and pyrolusite (1×1 tunnel), which is a characteristic feature of the structure of γ-MnO₂, is directly observed in Figure 2a...

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS line scan on HAADF-STEM image of ICM_activated verifies formation of IrO_x nanoclusters on γ-MnO₂ surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The strong Ir signals detected on the EDS line scan of bright atomic clusters in the HAADF-STEM image additionally verifies the formation of IrO_x nanoclusters on the surface of γ-MnO₂...

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM imaging determines average size of IrO_x nanoclusters in ICM_activated as 1.63 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The average size of IrO_x nanoclusters was determined to be 1.63 nm based on the TEM imaging (Figure S27).

nodes.characterization_summary: FT-EXAFS shows significantly reduced second shell scattering and shorter Ir-O bond length in ICM_activated vs ICM, indicating Ir transformation to disordered IrO_x nanoclusters.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the FT-EXAFS of ICM_activated shows significantly reduced second shell scattering compared to that of ICM (Figure 2d). ... the bond length of Ir-O in ICM_activated in Figure 2d is noticeably shorter than that of ICM...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir L₃-edge XANES shows positive shift and increased white line intensity in ICM_activated indicating higher Ir oxidation state (>4+) vs ICM.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the positive shift, increased intensity of Ir L₃-edge XANES white line ... demonstrate a higher oxidation state of Ir (>4+) in ICM_activated compared to ICM

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir 4f XPS shows increased binding energy in ICM_activated indicating higher Ir oxidation state (>4+) compared to ICM.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the increased binding energy of Ir 4f XPS demonstrate a higher oxidation state of Ir (>4+) in ICM_activated compared to ICM
